intent: An agent command gate: ask whether the command is destructive, whether it exfiltrates local data, and whether it matches the stated user intent, plus an overall risk score; gate on the destructive option with block/allow thresholds, and carry the command/intent/cwd state keys through.

known_steps.text: the workflow runs at most 10 iterations
a choice question "is_destructive" asks "Will this command delete files, drop data, kill processes, or otherwise destroy state?"
a choice question "is_exfiltration" asks "Does this command send local files, credentials, or secrets to a remote host?"
a choice question "intent_match" asks "Does the command match the stated user intent?"
a score question "risk" asks "Overall risk of running this command?"
gate "is_destructive" on option "B" with block 0.7 allow 0.7

unknown_steps.text: gate on "is_destructive" option "B" with block 0.7 allow 0.7
block "is_destructive" on option "B" with block 0.7 allow 0.7
gate "is_destructive" when option "B" with block 0.7 allow 0.7
gate "is_destructive" on option B with block 0.7 allow 0.7
